name: v36_sales_surprise_event_novelty
hypothesis: Actual sales beats should be more informative when the firm is connected to novel and entity-relevant news, because the market may underreact to demand information arriving through less routine events.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_novelty_score, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_entity_relevance_score, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: First non-neighbor extension of rKoO0M89: sales actual surprise reduced to 40%, with low-alphaCount news18 novelty/relevance.

name: v36_sales_surprise_option_confirmation
hypothesis: Sales delivery above consensus may be stronger when option-market directional pressure confirms upside and IV risk premium is not elevated.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Combines sales actual surprise with option confirmation; reject if it maps to QPa7KOGK or rKoO0M89.

name: v36_sales_surprise_partner_breadth
hypothesis: Actual sales beats may be more persistent when the firm has broader partner relationships, suggesting demand channel breadth rather than one-off accounting noise.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_novelty_score, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Partner breadth is crowded but economically different from sales estimate dispersion; strict corr gate required.

name: v36_sales_surprise_guidance_midpoint
hypothesis: A sales actual beat is more credible when the company's own quarterly guidance midpoint is above sell-side consensus.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank((sales_min_guidance_quarterly + sales_max_guidance_quarterly) / (2 * sales_estimate_average_quarterly), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * sales_estimate_stddev_quarterly / abs(sales_estimate_average_quarterly), 126), industry)
notes: Uses guidance midpoint and sales dispersion, but not estimate count; watch correlation to akdb1ZqR and rKoO0M89.

name: v36_sales_guidance_event_novelty
hypothesis: Positive company sales guidance relative to consensus, paired with novel/relevant news, may capture forward demand without using actual sales realization directly.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((sales_min_guidance_quarterly + sales_max_guidance_quarterly) / (2 * sales_estimate_average_quarterly), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_novelty_score, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_entity_relevance_score, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: No actual-sales term; checks whether guidance + novelty can be an independent follow-up.

name: v36_quarterly_sales_over_annual_context
hypothesis: Quarterly sales beats should matter more when they exceed the firm's slower annual sales delivery context, isolating acceleration rather than persistent high sales scale.
notes: Quarterly-vs-annual context; intentionally subtracts annual sales delivery rank to avoid cloning rKoO0M89.

name: v36_option_breakeven_event_novelty
hypothesis: Option directional pressure may be more robust when it coincides with novel firm-specific news and low IV risk premium, without using accounting or share-count anchors.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_event_novelty_score, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Low-correlation option rescue without sales actual, dilution, close/open, or accounting quality.

name: v36_event_novelty_relevance_risk
hypothesis: Novel and entity-relevant news under low systematic-risk deterioration may carry residual information independent of earnings/revenue RavenPack fields.
notes: Pure news18 novelty/relevance probe; likely weaker, but useful to assess whether novelty is more than a stabilizer.
